decisions.reason: FABPUB SL-2 changes only the internal broker transaction and recovery implementation; it adds no CLI syntax or public configuration. FABPUB SL-4 owns the changelog and release-facing documentation.

JAILCORE SL-4 updates the contract and capabilities documentation for the shipped four-rung route resolver, closed descend list, named exceptions, inactive remote mode and disabled-by-default capacity gate. The docs-catalog rescan helper is unavailable; a manual catalog audit found no catalog or launch-reference changes.

TEAMHOST SL-6 reconciles the managed-release subject, doctor vocabulary, administrator checklist, Gemini transition and deferred post-0.7.29 standard-host receipt with the landed route and authority contracts.

CODEX SL-3 records the owner's OD-4 acceptance, registered review-seat jail, retired inner-sandbox retention and review-seat owner fallback. The catalog rescan helper is absent; manual catalog audit found no new launch primitive or launch-reference row. SL-4 retains row-window promotion and post-merge issue closure.

JOURNAL SL-2 documents the internal run_status and run_status_projection API, fixed per-user root, storage layout, trust checks, reservation and fsync order, crash windows, manual quarantine, diagnostics, caps, closed phrases, the Linux-only writer and the unsupported same-login forgery boundary. No CLI or public configuration changes. A manual catalog audit found that .claude/docs-catalog.json lists no supervised docs, so it is unchanged.

PLACECLI SL-3 documents the agent-harness-placement process boundary: messages, exit classes and the client flag; the operator configuration and config_sha256; provider refusal and the effective-egress digest with the v2 bare-hex spelling (P-S2); barriers, replay and caller-scoped reap; local and remote Pi policies; per-host headroom defaults; fail-closed PSI and caps readiness, including the unreadable-caps behavior; the credential-proxy bridge; and the toolkit cutover conditions.
